title: CommitOptions
summary: Keep a browser cross-document view transition when a route's viewTransition commits a departure.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Pass to commit when next.leaving is true. crossDocument keeps the browser's cross-document transition into a same-origin destination and adds its types, possibly none, to the leaving document's transition. Smolter opts the leaving document in for that departure only. A plain commit skips the transition. In-document commits ignore the options. The destination opts in with its own @view-transition rule.
